name: Recharge
description: Recharge subscriptions become events: Subscription Started, Reactivated and Cancelled, Upcoming Charge, Charge Paid (with its amount and currency), Charge Failed and Charge Skipped, on the subscriber's profile. Subscribers are held back from marketing: Recharge doesn't record a marketing opt-in.

signature_secret.label: Recharge API Client Secret
signature_secret.help: Recharge → Tools and apps → API tokens → your token. The Edit API token page shows the API Client Secret (not the same as the token).

setup: Create the integration from this recipe and copy its webhook URL.
In Recharge, create an API token (Tools and apps → API tokens) with read access to customers, subscriptions and orders. Save its API Client Secret as the integration's signing secret.

Create one Recharge webhook per topic with POST https://api.rechargeapps.com/webhooks (header X-Recharge-Version: 2021-11). Add the topic to the end of the webhook URL so DumbMail knows which one it is, for example {"address": "<webhook URL>?topic=charge/paid", "topic": "charge/paid"}. The topics: customer/created, customer/updated, subscription/created, subscription/activated, subscription/cancelled, charge/upcoming, charge/updated, charge/paid, charge/failed.
Make a test change in Recharge and check the delivery log. A subscription that arrives before its customer is tried again a few minutes later.
Subscribers are held back from marketing. The suggested upcoming-charge reminder is a service message about their own subscription, so it still reaches them. Review it and turn it on.

flows.name: Recharge: upcoming charge reminder
flows.description: When Recharge says a charge is coming up, tells the subscriber what will be charged and when, so they can skip or change it. Not sent once that charge is paid, skipped or failed. A service message about their own subscription.

content.subject: Your next order is coming up
content.preheader: Change or skip it before {{ event.properties.scheduled_at }}

blocks.html:
Hi {{ first_name|default('there') }}, we'll charge {{ event.properties.total_price }} {{ event.properties.currency }} on {{ event.properties.scheduled_at }}.

Want to skip it or change what's in it? You can do that from your account.
